verdict.rationale: Expensify documents point-of-spend coding: SmartScan reads merchant, date and total in realtime, matches the receipt to the card transaction automatically, and auto-categorizes expenses as they're created, with multi-level GL coding and a daily chart-of-accounts sync. Hands-on community reports concretely contradict two of these claims. One user says categorization is wrong about 70% of the time (airplane tickets labeled 'WiFi'). Another says a few receipts took about 20 minutes to process, so they entered the data by hand, against the 'realtime, no delays' claim. Receipt data capture itself is corroborated by another user. Missing for 10: reliable auto-categorization accuracy, evidence of memo/description capture at the point of spend, and independent confirmation of realtime processing.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: SmartScan reads the merchant, date, total, and currency automatically
